annotations.title: Nano Banana Pro (Gemini Image) Visual Asset & Diagram Generator

description: Generates photorealistic illustrations, UI mockups, and technical diagrams from text prompts using the Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 2.5 Flash Image) model family. Use when creating static visual assets, icons, or architecture diagrams from text descriptions; for synthesizing animated multi-second video clips with motion, use generate_veo_cinematic_video instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'prompt' ('aspect_ratio' defaults to '1:1'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (75 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

aspect_ratio.description: Output image aspect ratio; defaults to '16:9' when omitted.

prompt.description: Detailed visual scene, composition, lighting, and typography description to render.

name: generate_nano_banana_image

output.description: Generated image payload or asset descriptor.

success.description: True when visual asset synthesis succeeded.
